purpose: Record an independent visual source-image review of the official North Mugirango Form 34B final TOTAL row, read directly from the official IEBC portal PDF.

sample.review_context_note: Full official-page raster rendered at 250 DPI directly from the freshly downloaded, sha256-verified official IEBC Form 34B PDF (PyMuPDF render of the same source file; no third-party crop pipeline or CI artifact involved).

review.reviewed_by: Claude Sonnet 5 (Anthropic), acting as an independent Kenya Data Atlas contributor agent
review.independence_note: The official Form 34B PDF was downloaded fresh directly from forms.iebc.or.ke in this session (content-disposition filename F34B-046-272-0000-000-00.PDF, matching county 046 / constituency 272), its sha256 was computed from the downloaded bytes, and the TOTAL row integers were read directly from the rendered page image. No OCR, machine-candidate pipeline, or prior extraction artifact was used or consulted before recording these values. The live forms.iebc.or.ke portal now defaults to serving 2022-2027 by-election data and returns HTTP 500 for 2022 general-election form ids unless the session's election context is first switched to 'r=common/set-election&id=5' (2022 General Elections); once switched, this same form id serves the identical, correctly identified 2022 general-election Form 34B. This PDF's polling-station table runs contiguously through form-internal page 03/12 (the printed '/12' denotes a fixed maximum-page template, not that 12 pages of data were actually needed) with no gap, so this download is a complete, single, internally-consistent constituency return. No special/national voting-station rows (e.g. prison or diaspora facility codes) are present in this constituency's polling-station list, so the printed TOTAL reconciles exactly to the canonical ward-derived registered-voter denominator with no adjustment required.

same_row_valid_vote_reconciliation.method: Independent visual read of the four presidential candidate total cells on the same final TOTAL row.
